report:
Soft tissue, left inguinal hernia sac, excision

Received in formalin is a membranous sac labelled left inguinal hernia sac, measuring 4 x 3 x 0.5 cm. Representative sections in 1 block.

(1) Hernia sac, representative sections.

Sections show peritoneal fibroadipose tissue lined by benign mesothelium. A segment of vas deferens is present in the wall of the sac. Features are in keeping with a hernia sac. There is no evidence of granulomatous inflammation or malignancy.

SOFT TISSUE, left inguinal hernia sac, excision - In keeping with HERNIA SAC; VAS DEFERENS IDENTIFIED; see comment

Vas deferens or epididymal tissue is identified in the wall of the hernia sac. Correlation with the operative findings is suggested.
